title: Opportunity AI vs Efficiency AI
description:
Efficiency AI is maintaining the status quo, while Opportunity AI is how you push the boundaries of your AI integration. 

- Instead of just SAVING TIME 

- Implement AI that MULTIPLIES OUTPUT 

When you can turn a single person, into the output of 10, you succeed with AI
